fields.description: The AI service used by every use case that does not name one of its own. Set this and Crema works everywhere, without configuring each use case.
fields.label: Default Provider

fields.description: The model used by every use case that does not name one of its own. Pick a Default Provider first — the list comes from it.
fields.label: Default Model

fields.description: The account Crema acts as when a use case does not name one of its own. Set up on install with a dedicated, low-access account. It cannot be Administrator or a System Manager.
fields.label: Default Runs-As User

fields.description: The most a use case may spend per calendar month when it has no limit of its own. 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Default Monthly Budget (USD)

fields.description: One row per use case. Leave Provider, Model, or Runs As empty to use the matching default above; fill one in only to send that one use case somewhere else. Crema keeps this list complete — rows cannot be added or removed by hand.
fields.label: Use Cases

fields.description: Log entries older than this are deleted automatically, once a day.
fields.label: Keep Logs For (days)
